## Checklist

- [ ] I've read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and signed the [CLA](../CLA.md) (the bot will prompt on your first PR)
- [ ] Both test suites pass locally (`php artisan test` in the composer container, `npm test`)
- [ ] New/changed behavior has test coverage
- [ ] For `/api/v1` changes: scope added and `docs/openapi.v1.json` regenerated
- [ ] No secrets, private hostnames, or personal data in the diff
